papers.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
papers.review_scope: Sections 2.2-2.4, Algorithm 1, section 3 and author gradient projection code
papers.caveat: No OSRAM gradient conflict or benefit established. TF reference requires explicit shared/private-parameter and mean-reduction adaptation.

papers.title: Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent for Multi-task Learning
papers.review_scope: Sections 3.1-3.2, Algorithm 1 and toy.py cagrad/pcgrad functions; inspected supervised utils
papers.caveat: Adds a control parameter and inner optimization; stated convergence conditions do not establish Adam or W-F1 guarantees.

papers.title: Side-Tuning: A Baseline for Network Adaptation via Additive Side Networks
papers.review_scope: Section 3.1 and sections 4.4-4.5; generic merge implementation and loader
papers.caveat: Frozen pretrained base conflicts with from-scratch joint one-stage training; code review did not trace all training/freezing code.

papers.title: Adapting Auxiliary Losses Using Gradient Similarity
papers.review_scope: Sections 2-3, Proposition 1 and following limitations; official implementation not verified
papers.caveat: Local gradient alignment does not guarantee positive transfer; deployed Full is not simply a discardable auxiliary task.
